create_adapter_batch_metadata: create an AdapterBatchMetadata dataclass with adapter indices, adapter set, segments, and segment indices tensors
add_adapter_to_layer: add an adapter with a given index and weights to a LayerAdapterWeights instance
remove_adapter_from_layer: remove an adapter by index from a LayerAdapterWeights instance
get_batched_adapter_data: get batched adapter weight data from LayerAdapterWeights by bucketing adapters by batch class type
create_adapter_batch_data_from_meta: create an AdapterBatchData instance from AdapterBatchMetadata and a dictionary of LayerAdapterWeights
